questions.question:
Select the correct alternative to indicate the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Dough

2. Wheat

3. Grinding

4. Flour

5. Cooking
questions.solution:
Wheat comes first in the order.

It is followed by Grinding.

Grinding is followed by Flour.

Flour is followed by Dough.

Dough is followed by Cooking.

The correct logical order is,

Wheat (2) → Grinding (3) → Flour (4) → Dough (1) → Cooking (5)

Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

questions.question:

**Statements:**

All gardens are play-grounds

No play-ground is house.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some gardens are houses.

II. Some play-grounds are gardens.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follow
Neither Conclusion I nor II follows

Drawing the Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa2707533a99dd82c662c0d10980990c744a4c990e12cf6cc82278595ef46a9.png] 

Conclusion 1: Some gardens are houses → False (Possible but not definite)

Conclusion 2: Some play-grounds are gardens → True (This is definitely true)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbc4fbbbb7b2fd84f9e15cfe275affc5c8dfd50dba6228c1a67782f19d2852ef.png] 

Hence, “only conclusion 2” follow.

questions.question: In a code language, if ‘FOR’ is coded as ‘78’ then how will ‘TUB’ be coded in the same language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7c921427880d156aa3a3621f473e6b1e9e0c0053ea79a2fbc4ea673ac14bb08.png] 

The pattern followed is,

For FOR,

The place value of F is 6

The place value of O is 15

The place value of R is 18

FOR = (6 + 15 + 18) × 2 = 78

Similarly,

For TUB,

The place value of T is 20

The place value of U is 21

The place value of B is 2

TUB = (20 + 21 + 2) × 2 = 86

Hence, “86” is the correct answer.
